title: feat(search): add fuzzy search mode with subsequence matcher
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Adds an opt-in `fuzzy` toggle to the search panel (`plugin-search`) that navigates documents with a fzf-style subsequence matcher instead of literal/regular-expression matching.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Issue: n/a
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): #17 — Fuzzy search (`plugin-search`, P2, `Needs OpenSpec: No`)
- OpenSpec change: none required (feature is additive, scoped to `plugin-search`, no new capability/breaking API)

Long docs are hard to grep when you don't remember the exact spelling. A fuzzy (subsequence) matcher lets users type an approximate query (`hwd` → `hello world`) and jump straight to the result, matching the UX of tools like fzf and VS Code's `#` quick search.

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/plugin-search`:
  - **New pure module `src/fuzzy.ts`** — `fuzzyMatch(query, text, caseSensitive)` returns a score + matched positions for a subsequence match; `findFuzzyMatches(doc, query, options)` scans the document line-by-line so a match span never crosses a newline. Scoring rewards consecutive runs and word-boundary/start-of-string hits, and applies a length penalty so tighter matches win. Note: this is a **greedy** matcher (first-fit per query char); a backtracking matcher is deferred as future work (documented in the roadmap row).
  - **`src/index.ts`** — new `fuzzy` option on `SearchOptions`/`SearchPluginOptions`/`SearchPluginLabels` (default off, so existing behavior is unchanged); `nexusSearchStateField` StateField tracks query/fuzzy/caseSensitive; a ViewPlugin renders fuzzy matches with highlight decorations; `fuzzyFindNext` / `fuzzyFindPrevious` / `fuzzySelectAll` / `fuzzyReplaceNext` / `fuzzyReplaceAll` commands; panel gains a `Fuzzy` checkbox and branches navigation/replace between literal and fuzzy paths; `createSearchPlugin` wires the keymap (`Mod-g` / `Mod-Shift-g`) and highlight plugin.
  - **`package.json`** — adds `@codemirror/state` direct dependency (was previously only transitive).
- `docs/ROADMAP.md` — #17 status `planned` → `in-progress`, notes updated to describe the greedy-subsequence approach.

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` passes — **551/551** across 35 files (was 537 before this PR; +14 new cases)
- [x] Affected packages build — `@floatboat/nexus-core` and `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-search` tsup builds (ESM + DTS) succeed; `tsc --noEmit` clean for `plugin-search`
- [x] New / updated vitest cases:
  - `packages/plugin-search/test/fuzzy.test.ts` (12 tests) — subsequence matching, case sensitivity, scoring order, line-span / newline-boundary / multi-line behavior
  - `packages/plugin-search/test/plugin-search.test.ts` (2 new) — fuzzy toggle wiring in the panel: fuzzy navigation selects the expected span and highlights render; highlight is absent when the toggle is off
- [ ] Manual UI check in electron-demo — not run (jsdom coverage only)

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [ ] **CLA signed** — first-time contributor; will be prompted by the CLA bot
- [x] **AI disclosure**: the functional code in this PR was developed with AI assistance (this is a take-home assignment that permits AI tooling). The submitter reviewed and can explain every design decision — matcher scoring, per-line matching semantics, state-field/effect wiring, and the greedy-vs-backtracking trade-off. AI-assisted notes: AI drafted the implementation and tests; human-reviewed and validated locally.
- [x] **New dependencies**: `@codemirror/state@^6.4.0` — MIT — required for `StateField` / `StateEffect` / `EditorSelection` used by the fuzzy state and highlight wiring (previously a transitive dependency of `@codemirror/search` / `@codemirror/view`).
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed (`dist/` is git-ignored)
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits — `feat(search): ...`
- [x] Public API changes update package README / types — `fuzzy` option added to exported types; package has no README (consistent with sibling plugins)
- [x] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` → n/a (no core/live-preview changes)
- [x] New capability / breaking change → OpenSpec proposal linked — n/a (additive plugin-scoped feature; roadmap row already marks `Needs OpenSpec: No`)
- [x] Change aligns with project scope (GOVERNANCE.md §4) — roadmap item #17

## Screenshots / Recordings · 截图或录屏 (UI changes)

Not provided — panel toggle verified via jsdom integration tests.

commits_at_first_review.message:
feat(search): add fuzzy search mode with subsequence matcher

Implements roadmap #17. Adds an opt-in 'fuzzy' toggle to the search panel
that navigates with a fzf-style subsequence matcher (consecutive-run and
word-boundary bonuses, length penalty). The matcher is a pure, unit-tested
module; panel integration is covered by jsdom tests.
